predecessors.name: Visigothic Kingdom
predecessors.text: Seville, taken by Athanagild against Agila

successors.name: Visigothic Kingdom
successors.text: Seville, taken by Athanagild against Agila

ledger.x: 551: Athanagild rebels against King Agila and takes Seville.
554: Agila dies and Athanagild reigns alone.

wars.name: Visigothic civil war of Agila and Athanagild
wars.outcome: Athanagild takes Seville, wins with Byzantine help and becomes sole king; the Byzantines keep a province on the south coast.

certainty.note: The pages name only Seville; the extent of the rebel land is not given.
